intro.title: FUNDA — Virtual Employee Directory
intro.body: In this lesson you will build a Virtual Employee Directory that renders a list of 10,000 employee cards with avatars, names, departments, and status badges without perceptible lag. Using Angular CDK's cdk-virtual-scroll-viewport, only the cards visible in the viewport are ever in the DOM. Combined with trackBy, OnPush change detection, and NgOptimizedImage for lazy avatar loading, you will produce a performant directory that feels native regardless of dataset size.
intro.usecase: Large list performance is one of the most frequently cited pain points in enterprise Angular applications — HR directories, customer lists, product catalogues, audit logs. Interviewers will ask how you have handled performance for large datasets.
